sentences.en: She complained continually that there was no money left.
Human beings, whether they realise it or not, continually seek happiness.
sentences.zh: 无论人们是否意识到，人类一直在寻求幸福。

sentences.en: Peter is continually making phone calls to his mother.
sentences.zh: 彼得一直给妈妈打电话。

senses.zh: 不停地；持续地屡屡地,一再地
